name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index 99 and US 10-year yield 5.15% on 13 Nov after soft 10- and 30-year auctions
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility was near 99 on 13 Nov, 6% higher on the week and 42% higher over three months (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield closed the week near 5.15%; the 10 Nov 10-year auction cleared at 5.02% and the 12 Nov 30-year at 5.44%, both described as weak (Wolf Street, 14 Nov). MOVE sits just under the 100 line but has not cleared the exit margin, so Watch holds.
for_you: Higher and jumpier government bond yields tend to feed into mortgage and loan pricing over the following weeks.
rubric_hit: MOVE 98.8 has not yet cleared the 90 exit line, so Watch holds

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofAML MOVE Index
Wolf Street — Treasury yields snap back after rough 10- and 30-year auctions

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
